name: Primal Instinct
source:
You take the role of a young man, about to embark on his honeymoon with his beloved wife: Meghan. A honeymoon is supposed to be a wonderful memory a loving couple will look back on, and cherish, when they have grown old together. But not everything goes according to plan...especially when there are unforeseen circumstances involved.

Do you break under pressure and give in, or do you stay the course, even when the odds seem stacked against you?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/SilkandMilkProductions]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个年轻人的角色，即将与他心爱的妻子梅根开始度蜜月。蜜月应该是一对恩爱夫妻在白头偕老后回想并珍惜的美好回忆。但并非一切都按计划进行……尤其是当涉及不可预见的情况时。

你会在压力下屈服并屈服，还是会坚持到底，即使机会似乎对你不利？

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/SilkandMilkProductions]Patreon[/url]]
